purpose: Reserve a fixed, same-protocol, local-only Causal-LoCoMo table before any real score is observed, including explicit non-comparable blocker cells and a locked AgentEnhance row.

admission_rules.numeric_source: Only a terminal-accepted local matched run scored by the frozen independent evaluator may populate a numeric cell.
admission_rules.official_or_development_values: Remain in separate disclosure artifacts and may not populate this table.
admission_rules.eligible_failure_rows: Remain in all 261 registered rows under the prospectively frozen conservative imputation policy.
admission_rules.protocol_blocked_rows: Keep all numeric cells blank and status PROTOCOL_BLOCKED.
admission_rules.agentenhance_row: Keep all numeric cells blank until the recent-baseline gate is accepted prospectively.
admission_rules.partial_method_results: May not populate the method row.
admission_rules.sota_claim: Not authorized by this template; any later claim requires complete admitted evidence and a separately audited comparison statement.

slice_outputs_required_after_admission: method by task_family over all seeds
paired method-minus-no-memory by example and seed
paired method-minus-full-history by example and seed
authorization: Result-free table design only. It authorizes no real execution, scoring, result admission, superiority or SOTA claim, archive deletion, or model cleanup.
